docs.title: slots-gambling
docs.text:
Jump to Message Before The Slot Machine is a feature in GeneratorCraft that allows you to gamble using Slot Tokens. The three slots in the GUI will roll a random item, if all three slots match the same item, the item is dropped as a reward. The loot has a forgiving system. Every spin adds 1 to the forgive counter. When the forgive counter surpasses 75 the table used to define the 3 items becomes much more empty and fair. When the counter reaches 200 it resets. The unforgiving table can have any GeneratorCraft item. The forgiving tables make all 3 slots include only: - Lootbox related items

after The Slot Machine is a feature in GeneratorCraft that allows you to gamble using Slot Tokens. The three slots in the GUI will roll a random item, if all three slots match the same item, the item is dropped as a reward. The loot has a forgiving system. Every spin adds 1 to the forgive counter. When the forgive counter surpasses 75 the table used to define the 3 items becomes much more empty and fair. When the counter reaches 200 it resets. The unforgiving table can have any GeneratorCraft item. The forgiving tables make all 3 slots include only: - Lootbox related items - Weapon related items - Generator related items - Generator Upgrades related items - Currency related items

docs.title: announcements
docs.text:
Jump to Message Before @everyone 1.2.6 has just been released and will be available to download shortly. This is probably one of the biggest updates since 1.1.5 Changes: - Some numbers should now display commas (",") if too big - Main Menu, Background Dirt, and Menu Panorama have been changed to fit GeneratorCraft's aesthetic - Added some buttons to the main menu - Added custom Splash Texts to the main menu - Coins and Gems will now display less than 1 coin (e.g., 5 coins → 5.25 coins) - Events Rework: All events now run under the same clock instead of separately

  • Every 50 minutes, a random event will take place for 25 minutes

  • New Event: EmptiX Trade-in Event

  • Upon eating food or drinking potions, a waste item will be dropped

  • Waste items may be exchanged with the generous EmptiX corporation for Deposit Tokens

  • Deposit Tokens may be used in the EmptiX Store while the event is active

  • *(N...

2025-03-16 00:39 The Money Sheep is a mob that can spawn in the Biome of Wealth (

docs.title: biome-of-wealth

docs.title: Changes:
docs.text:
• Gem and Fortunite armor are now trimmable
  • Added a new mob variant: Wealthy. Zombies, Skeletons, and Creepers may spawn with a fancy suit. They are slightly tougher than their regular counterparts but provide more loot upon death
  • Gem Core Shrine can now only generate in Desert or Biome of Wealth
  • The Hoarder's GUI now displays the item they are looking to buy

  • Added the Gemstone Obelisk: a new trophy Gem Shop item for the low price of 100,000 Gems

  • You may convert it back to 100,000 Gems using /convertobelisk

  • Right-Clicking the Obelisk sets an owner to it, ensuring you can display it at full glory without worrying about thieves

  • Added the FrikandelBroodje Speciaal sword (Weapons Lootbox)
  • Added the Sword and Crown of Greed (Gilded Crown/Sword of Sinful Greediness). They may drop from Wealthy mobs

  • Added a new enchantment: RNG Miner

  • It goes up to level 3, conflicts with Silk Touch and Fortune

  • It can be obtained through the Enchantment Table, Existing book loot tables, and villager trades

  • When mining ores, there's a (1/(50,000-(EnchantLevel*10,000))) chance for an RNG rain to trigger

2025-03-15 23:25 After killing a mob , Coins, Gems and Lootboxes may drop according to the player's respective chances The formulas are as such: Coin Drop amount from non monster entities = ((MaxHP/2)+Random[1-10])*CoinMultiplier Coin Drop amount from monster entities = (((MaxHP/2)+Random[1-10)+(MaxHP/2))*CoinMultiplier Gem Drop amount from non monster entities = ((MaxHP/5)+Random[1-5])*GemMultiplier Gem Drop amount from monster entities = (((MaxHP/5)+Random[1-10)+(MaxHP/5))*GemMultiplier If the Looting enchantment is present this amount is added(+) at the end of the formula: Coins = CoinDrop*((1.5*LootingLevel)+(Random[1-10]) Gems = GemDrop*((1*LootingLevel)+(Random[1-10]) Lootbox Drop: Lootboxes will drop according to your Box Chance. If the weapon has Looting there exists a formula to drop another Lootbox: if Random[LootingLevel-10]

= 5

ignDante

2025-04-26 01:51 The World Bank The World Bank is a feature added in the 1.2.6 update of GeneratorCraft. - Every world has a default world bank amount of 1,000,000 - The World Bank only deals in Coins

The state of the World Bank's currency affect the Economy Boost and the Economy State: - <-500,000 = Economy Boost: 0.1x, Economy State: Collapsed - <0 = Economy Boost: 0.25x, Economy State: Debt Crisis - <200,000 = Economy Boost: 0.5x, Economy State: Depression - <500,000 = Economy Boost: 0.75x, Economy State: Recession - <1,000,000 = Economy Boost: 1x, Economy State: Stable - <2,000,000 = Economy Boost: 1.25x, Economy State: Booming - <5,000,000 = Economy Boost: 1.5x, Economy State: Overheated - <10,000,000 = Economy Boost: 2x, Economy State: Inflated - >9,999,999 = Economy Boost: 3x, Economy State: Hyperinflation

If the Economy Boost stat is above 1x, it will only affect the prices of things (ex. upgrades, shop items)

If the Economy Boost is below 1x, it will only affect the output of things (ex. coins from mob kill, daily rewards) The World Bank may be affected with the /loan command (

docs.title: loan
docs.text:
) or by adding or removing coins via purchasing upgrades, shop items, killing mobs or obtaining rewards Reaching your coin limit in the bank or in your wallet will give the extra coins to the bank

02:17 @everyone 1.2.6 has just been released and will be available to download shortly. This is probably one of the biggest updates since 1.1.5 Changes: - Some numbers should now display commas (",") if too big - Main Menu, Background Dirt, and Menu Panorama have been changed to fit GeneratorCraft's aesthetic - Added some buttons to the main menu - Added custom Splash Texts to the main menu - Coins and Gems will now display less than 1 coin (e.g., 5 coins → 5.25 coins) - Events Rework: All events now run under the same clock instead of separately

  • Every 50 minutes, a random event will take place for 25 minutes

  • New Event: EmptiX Trade-in Event

  • Upon eating food or drinking potions, a waste item will be dropped

  • Waste items may be exchanged with the generous EmptiX corporation for Deposit Tokens

  • Deposit Tokens may be used in the EmptiX Store while the event is active

  • (Note: the store currently isn't selling anything)

  • Added Current Event display under the currency overlay

  • Added three new stats: World Bank, Economy State, and Economy Boost/Multiplier

  • World Bank: Value of coins the "world" has (new world starts at 1,000,000)

  • You can request a loan using /loan [request/repay] [amount]Failure to repay will result in a blockage of income

  • Economy State reflects the health of the economy

  • Economy Boost/Multiplier affects prices and outputAbove 1x → gets added to pricesBelow 1x → gets added to output of purchases

  • For more info, refer to the GeneratorCraft Wiki Discord

Fixes: - Removed Herobrine
